Unsupported entities remain visible as an evidence gap."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Version 0.2.0 is host-neutral and stock-Cordis-loader safe: it imports no private ToolRuntime helper"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" and exposes no default export, preserving the module-level `inject = ['tools']` contract. `TEXT`/`M"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"TEXT` bodies and malformed numeric tokens are represented only by SHA-256 plus length, so evidence o"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"utput does not reproduce drawing prose."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"This scope complements broader robotics suites such as dsh-robotic-harness: that project inventories"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" robot assets and validates URDF/MJCF/SDF workflows, while this plugin remains a small deterministic"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" ASCII-DXF entity/rule evidence layer."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Configure a workspace root and project-owned policy:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Paths must be `.dxf` files relative to `workspaceRoot`. Traversal, symlink escape, binary DXF and ov"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ersized input are refused."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## DSH tools"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- `dsh_cad_inspect_dxf` — source SHA-256, units, bounds, layers, entity counts and exact entity geom"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"etry/line evidence.
- `dsh_cad_review_dxf` — the same evidence plus a deterministic policy report. A"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" per-call `policyJson` can override configured policy."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The extractor understands LINE, LWPOLYLINE, CIRCLE, ARC, TEXT, MTEXT, POINT and INSERT geometry. Oth"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"er types are retained and reported as structurally unsupported rather than silently treated as revie"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ypes are retained and reported as structurally unsupported rather than silently treated as reviewed."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## MCP proof surface"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The formal `.mcp.json` declaration exposes `cad_dxf_inspect_inline` and `cad_dxf_review_inline`. The"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"y accept an explicit bounded ASCII DXF string, share the same parser and rule core, and return redac"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ted structured evidence entirely in memory. The MCP server cannot read files, access the network, ex"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"ecute drawing content, start subprocesses, or write artifacts."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Checks cover malformed numbers, zero-length lines, non-positive radii, polyline closure and declared"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" vertex count, exact duplicate geometry, required/forbidden layers, forbidden entity types, text hei"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"ght, units, drawing span and entity limits.
